summary: WEB-only E2E of the Strategy Center redesign + Strategy Health Dashboard. Owner login → STRATEGY tab: strategy-grid renders 16 library cards; ZERO card-grade-* badges on the grid (grade removed as specified); no leaderboard; no DEPLOYED/EDIT sub-tabs. Every card carries card-status-*, card-edit-*, and card-deploy-* (one primary Deploy/Manage). AddStrategyChooser exposes add-strategy-chooser + add-option-create + add-option-import + add-option-ai (AI is styled as a small link under a divider — clearly secondary). Detail view for hunter (PAPER strategy opened via card-deploy MANAGE): all 9 required test-ids present — detail-metrics (with 5 stats incl. detail-recent-form), detail-how-it-works, detail-best-used-in, detail-show-more toggles detail-more (health/live snapshot/AI), detail-actions with detail-test-strategy + detail-deploy-manage + detail-edit-parameters. Edit Parameters reveals detail-params; Manage in Paper reveals detail-manage with detail-status-select. Deploy flow on time-series-momentum (DISABLED): click card-deploy-* → backend POST /api/strategy/{key}/state DID flip status to PAPER (verified by direct API read). RESEARCH → HEALTH: strategy-health-panel renders exactly 6 health-card-* with matching health-badge-* + health-capture-* + best timeframe + best exit + metrics + regime chips. health-download-pdf visible. Owner trigger: health-run-toggle → health-run-warning shows scope (full/scoped) + window (3m/6m/1y) options + health-run-confirm. Clicking confirm returned HTTP 200 from POST /api/lab/health/run and health-progress bar appeared. Backend endpoints /api/lab/health, /api/lab/health/status, /api/lab/health/run, /api/strategy/metrics all return 200. Every spec requirement passes.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking card-deploy-* on a DISABLED strategy, the backend correctly flips DISABLED→PAPER, but the card-status-* badge in the grid did not visually update within ~3.5s of the click during the test. Direct API verification confirmed PAPER, so the toast + backend are correct — only the badge re-render lags because load() re-fetches asynchronously. Toast appears immediately; badge lag is cosmetic. Consider optimistic-update of status locally before the metrics reload lands.

Clicking 'Test in Research Lab' fires the ananta:navigate custom event (listener exists in AppShell:101), but during the test the Research tab (data-testid='research-page') was NOT visible 2s after the click. The pre-selected strategy is written to useResearchStore + localStorage before dispatch, so if the tab-switch is delayed or the researchStore reset elsewhere overrides it, users could land on the wrong sub-tab. Worth a manual re-verify — could be test-flake or a real timing bug in the navigate handler.

action_items: (Low) Optimistically update card-status-* badge immediately on successful strategySetState response so the DEPLOY→PAPER flip is visible without waiting for the metrics reload round-trip.

(Medium) Re-verify the 'Test in Research Lab' bottom action navigates cleanly to the Research → Validate sub-tab with the strategy pre-selected. If it lands on Health or a stale sub-tab, the localStorage('ananta_research_sub','validate') set in StrategyCenter:420 may be racing with Research.jsx's own useState initializer that also reads/removes that key on mount.
critical_code_review_comments: StrategyCenter.jsx is 900 lines — over the 700-line soft cap in the guidelines. StrategyLibrary / LibraryCard / StrategyDetail / CatalogDetail / AddStrategyChooser / SearchScreen / FilterDrawer could each live in their own file under /pages/strategy/ to make future edits safer.

LibraryCard.deploy() reloads via onDeploy?.() which calls the parent load() — this refetches BOTH metrics AND registry. If a future maintainer adds many cards on-screen this doubles unnecessary work. Consider a targeted single-strategy metrics patch after strategySetState returns.

StrategyHealthPanel.jsx polls /api/lab/health/status every 3s while a sweep is active, which is fine (12–13 min sweep = ~260 polls), but no backoff is applied on transient errors — the try/catch swallows all errors and keeps polling. Add a max-consecutive-failure cutoff so a broken endpoint doesn't spin forever.

Detail view: detail-grade still shows a grade chip next to detail-status. The user brief said 'grade removed from main grid' (verified — grid has none) but did not require removing it from the detail view, so this is intentional and consistent with the 'prominent status badge' change.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 endpoints verified: /api/auth/login, /api/strategy/metrics, /api/lab/health, /api/lab/health/run — POST 200 within a few seconds and health-progress rendered)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (18/19 spec check-points verified; 1 timing observation on Test-in-Research navigation)

seed_data_creation: One additional health sweep was TRIGGERED (POST /api/lab/health/run confirmed 200) but not awaited — a background sweep is now running (or already finished by the time you read this) in addition to the pre-existing completed sweep at run_id a2a3428c-e6fd-4562-adde-b87188b4a566. No paper trades or strategy edits created. time-series-momentum was flipped DISABLED→PAPER during the deploy-flow verification; if you want it back to DISABLED, POST /api/strategy/time-series-momentum/state with the correct payload/verb.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: click [data-testid='owner-login-button'], then fill locator('input').nth(0)='owner@ananta.ai', nth(1)=password (the two inputs have type='text' and 'password' — NOT type='email', so input[type='email'] selector times out). Dismiss onboarding-start-exploring + text 'Skip for Now' + text 'ENTER ANANTA', then set localStorage.ananta_onboarded='1'. Bottom-nav IDs are bottom-nav-{dashboard|strategies|research|workspace|trade}. STRATEGY grid has 16 cards; hunter/squeeze/continuation/ema-cross/supertrend/rsi-momentum are PAPER (MANAGE button), the rest are DISABLED (DEPLOY button). Research → HEALTH already has a completed sweep — cards render instantly (no need to trigger a sweep just to see data). If you re-run health-run-confirm and a sweep is already in progress, backend should return 409; the current run returned 200 because no other sweep was in-flight.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Two cosmetic/timing observations only, both non-blocking.
